posts.title: A new project
posts.description: It’s been pretty quiet around here lately, hasn’t it? I’ve been spending all my free time on a new project involving… stationery! I’m making pocket accordion note cards, like a pocket notebook but for more temporary use and without the fuss. Check out the Dayjo website and Instagram for more info.

posts.title: Google Maps, Internet and Population Density
posts.description: Join me on a random Internet rabbit hole. While relaxing on my porch during sunset, I wondered: Does Google Maps do collective routing? I’ve always wondered this. Turns out, no. Google Maps optimizes for the current user only. It blends real time data collected from other users with historical data. But doing this for each […]
